title: sudanese-asr-eval: split, normaliser and scoring for Sudanese Arabic ASR
description:
Code, speaker-disjoint split and text-free per-clip scores for the paper "What Is in a WER? Reproducible Evaluation of Whisper for Sudanese Arabic" (Saifuddin Ahmed, 2026). Includes an installable Python module and CLI with three text views (raw, Whisper basic, full Arabic normalisation), corpus WER/CER with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired tests, the Kaggle notebooks used for all runs, a script that recomputes every number in the paper, and a check of the arbml/sudanese_dialect_speech mirror alignment.

The split and scores are derived from the Sudanese dialect speech dataset by Ayman Mansour (Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6869079, CC BY 4.0). No audio is included. OOOK-Eval-Final is used for evaluation only and is not redistributed.
notes: Code: Apache-2.0. Split files and released scores (splits/, results/): CC BY 4.0, see LICENSE-DATA. The paper's arXiv identifier will be added as an isSupplementTo relation once available.
